steps.start: a point on the mean low water mark on the southerly natural boundary of Jefferd Creek where it flows into Thunder Bay

steps.until: a point 500 m upstream of the right-of-way of BC Hydro powerline
steps.quote: thence northerly up the creek to a point 500 m upstream of the right-of-way of BC Hydro powerline

steps.until: its intersection with the Lois River
steps.quote: thence westerly to its intersection with the Lois River
thence northerly and easterly along the west bank of the Lois River to the Lois Lake dam

steps.until: a point 500 m north of the right-of-way of the BC Hydro power line
steps.quote: thence along a straight line due West to a point 500 m north of the right-of-way of the BC Hydro power line

steps.side_or_bank: northerly boundary of the power line right of way
steps.quote: thence northwesterly parallel to the northerly boundary of the power line right of way at a perpendicular distance off 500 m from it to Kelly Creek

steps.until: the southern boundary of the BC Hydro power line
steps.quote: thence due South along a straight line to the southern boundary of the BC Hydro power line

steps.side_or_bank: southern boundary of the right of way
steps.until: the southeasternmost bay of Hammil Lake
steps.quote: thence northwesterly along the southern boundary of the British Columbia Hydro power line right of way to the southeasternmost bay of Hammil Lake
thence westerly and northwesterly along the mean low water mark of Hammil Lake to the outlet of Hammil Lake

steps.until: the mean low water mark of Haslam Lake
steps.quote: thence in a straight line due North to the mean low water mark of Haslam Lake
thence westerly along the mean low water mark of Haslam Lake to its westernmost point

steps.until: the southwesternmost point of Schmarge Bay, north of Powell Hill
steps.quote: thence in a straight line due northwest to the southwesternmost point of Schmarge Bay, north of Powell Hill

steps.until: the easterly boundary of the Sliammon Indian Reserve Number 1
steps.quote: thence due West in a straight line to the easterly boundary of the Sliammon Indian Reserve Number 1

steps.until: its intersection with the northerly boundary of the District Municipality of Powell River
steps.quote: thence southerly along the reserve boundary to its intersection with the northerly boundary of the District Municipality of Powell River

steps.until: a point on the boundary 500 m southerly from the mean low water mark on the natural boundary of Malaspina Strait
steps.quote: thence easterly and southerly along the district boundary to a point on the boundary 500 m southerly from the mean low water mark on the natural boundary of Malaspina Strait

steps.until: a point 500 m south of the southerly tip of an unnamed point of land which forms the westerly shore of Frolander Bay
steps.quote: thence generally southeasterly along a line 500 m from and parallel to the mean low water mark on the natural boundary of Malaspina Strait to a point 500 m south of the southerly tip of an unnamed point of land which forms the westerly shore of Frolander Bay

steps.until: the natural boundary of Frolander Bay
steps.quote: thence due East to the natural boundary of Frolander Bay

steps.until: the natural boundary of Thunder Bay
steps.quote: thence northeasterly along the base of a hill, which is located northeast of Frolander Bay, to the natural boundary of Thunder Bay
thence northerly along the mean low water mark on the natural boundary to the point of commencement
